title: Keramahan nyang jiba rasa teumakot .
intro: Lam saboh banda nyang ka jipeuhabéh lé keujahatan, sidroe hamba nyang seutia jiteurimong tamue nyang hana teuduga bak saboh uroe. Deungon khawatir keu keuseulamatan awaknyan, ureueng nyoe geubri perlindungan, tapi ureueng-ureueng kota nyan geutuntut sapeue-sapeue nyang malei. Dipeuingat keuhai azab nyang teuka, hamba nyan jiplueng ngon keuluarga jih dimiyueb tutupan seupôt, jitinggai saboh banda nyang ka jitanda keu hanco. Soe ureueng meuiman sidroe nyoe?
clues: Ulôn geukirém sibagoe utosan ubak saboh bansa nyang ka jipeubuet buet-buet nyang hina.
Tamu nyang hana teusangka-sangka teuka u rumoh lon, dan lon leubeh khawatir keu keselamatan awaknyan nibak lon keudroe.
Umat ​​ulôn jituntut keu jijak kalon tamue ulôn deungon niet jeuhet, dan ulôn cuba meu-alasan ngon awaknyan.
Peungunjong ulôn geupeugah droe awaknyan sibagoe malaikat dan geupeurintah ulôn mangat lôn cok keuluwarga lôn dan lôn jak bak malam uroe.
Peurumoh ulôn hana geutem deungoe panggilan untôk peuleupah droë dan geuhadapi kehancuran njang saban lagèë bansa ulôn.
Banda ulôn ka jitron lé ujeuen batée tanoh kliet nyang meulapéh-lapéh, bagian-bagian nyang paleng manyang jiba nyang paleng miyueb.

outcome.answer: Lon seulamat ngon keuluarga lon sigohlom kota lon teubalék .

arabic: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ
verse: He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support." (11:80)
